# Leaflet 1.9.4

Vendored from the official npm release to avoid executing a third-party CDN
script on the same origin as locally saved planning data. The BSD 2-Clause
license is included in LICENSE. CSS image paths are preserved. The unavailable
source-map reference was removed; executable JavaScript is otherwise unchanged.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/-/leaflet-1.9.4.tgz

Verified release integrity (SHA-512): `sha512-nxS1ynzJOmOlHp+iL3FyWqK89GtNL8U8rvlMOsQdTTssxZwCXh8N2NB3GDQOL+YR3XnWyZAxwQixURb+FA74PA==`

To update, obtain the official release, verify its published integrity, replace
these distribution files together, preserve its license, and test the run map.
